questions.subject: english
questions.stem: She ___ (like) apples.
questions.rubric: 检查三单形式；忘加 s 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: He ___ (go) to school by bike.
questions.rubric: 检查三单变化规则；go 忘加 es 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: There ___ a book on the desk. (单数)
questions.rubric: 检查 There be 主谓一致；用 are 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: The elephant is ___ than the cat.
questions.rubric: 检查比较级形式；选原级可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友问你：What will you do this weekend? 请用 will 说一个完整句子。
questions.answer: I will go to the park.
questions.rubric: 检查 will + 动词原形结构；will 后加三单可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 在商店想买一件衣服，用英语问价格（完整句子）。
questions.rubric: 检查 How much 问价句型；How many 混淆可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你在街上迷路了，用英语礼貌地向陌生人问去车站的路。
questions.answer: Excuse me, where is the bus station?
questions.rubric: 检查礼貌问路句型；Excuse me 缺失可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which are healthy food and drinks? Select ALL.
questions.rubric: 检查健康饮食概念；错选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: What will you do next weekend? 请用 will 写一个完整句子。
questions.rubric: 检查 will + 动词原形；will 后加三单可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用比较级比较大象和猫，写一个完整句子（提示：big）。
questions.answer: The elephant is bigger than the cat.
questions.rubric: 检查比较级 + than 结构；用原级可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which word means “高兴的”？
questions.rubric: 情绪词义映射；错选 excited 时教师可补充进阶。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I am very ______ (excited) ______ (about) the trip.
questions.rubric: 检查 excited about 搭配；漏 about 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友问你：You look tired. How do you feel? 请用完整英语回答。
questions.answer: I feel tired today. I didn’t sleep well last night.
questions.rubric: 检查 I feel + 情绪词；只说 I’m tired 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which word describes “下雪的”？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Spell the word “温度” → t_______e
questions.rubric: temperature 拼写漏 e 可标记 spelling_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 天气预报主播请你播报：今天上海 stormy，温度 18 度。请用 2-3 句英语播报。
questions.answer: It is stormy in Shanghai today. The temperature is about 18 degrees. Please stay safe!
questions.rubric: 检查复合形容词 + 温度句型 + 安全提示；缺温度可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 去商店买东西，下面哪些表达正确？(可多选)
questions.rubric: How much (价格不可数) 与 How many (数量可数) 区分。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 请用 2 句话介绍你的一项爱好：My hobby is ___. I can ___.
questions.answer: My hobby is playing basketball. I can play it with my friends after school.
questions.rubric: 检查 hobby + V-ing 与 can + V 原形结构。
